title: The Unstruck Shehai
summary: Ansei pilgrims and constellation keepers between Hunding's Dojo, the Hall of the Ansei, and Tall Papa's Spire stop fault-vault seekers from breaking the seal on the Vault of the Pankratosword.

hook.rumour: Relic-hunters landed a barge below Tall Papa's Spire with star-charts pointing to the fault-line beneath the Hall of the Ansei, and the keepers at Hunding's Dojo are arming.
hook.notice: HUNDING'S DOJO PILGRIM HALL: Sworn blades needed to guard the constellation markers from Tall Papa's Spire to the Hall of the Ansei.

npcs.name: Warden of Hunding's Dojo
npcs.greet: Relic-hunters landed a barge below Tall Papa's Spire with star-charts pointing to the fault-line beneath the Hall of the Ansei, and the keepers at Hunding's Dojo are arming.
talk: The trouble across the Yokudan Desert began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Hunding's Dojo.
If you mean to help the Ansei Keepers of Yokuda, start by checking the trail between Hundings Dojo and Temple of Satakal.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Hunding's Dojo
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Temple of Satakal is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Temple of Satakal toward Hall of the Ansei before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Hunding's Dojo so Sword-Keeper Nazar can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Hall of the Ansei
npcs.greet: You made good time from Temple of Satakal. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Sand Drowned Village.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Sand Drowned Village with a picked guard.
Once Sand Drowned Village is cleared, return to Hunding's Dojo to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Hunding's Dojo
npcs.greet: Sword-Keeper Nazar awaits word on whether the crisis in the Yokudan Desert has been contained.
talk: The elders of Hunding's Dojo have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of the Yokudan Desert owes you a debt for standing between Hundings Dojo and ruin.

story_yokudan_desert_boss_03.name: Usurper-Captain of Hall of the Ansei (3)
